ref: Full-body cinematic photo of a young woman in her twenties of mixed European and East Asian appearance, dark brown hair pulled back in a low ponytail, blue eyes, a plain white tank top, and an orange jumpsuit worn only from the waist down: its empty upper half and sleeves hang down and are knotted around her waist, a white wristband on one wrist, wearing white sci-fi long-fall boots, no knee pads: smooth glossy white boots up to mid-calf, and on the back of each a long curved white spring blade that runs from the calf down and curls under behind the heel, so she stands slightly raised on the blades, carrying a portal gun held in both hands across her body at hip level the way a soldier carries a rifle: short and chunky, about 60 centimetres long, NO stock, NO scope, NO magazine; its rear half is a bulbous glossy white egg-shaped shell tucked under her right forearm, its front half a fat black ribbed cylinder, and three thin black curved claws reach forward from the muzzle like pincers around a glowing blue tip. She stands in the middle of a bright sterile white test chamber of square white wall panels with thin dark seams, facing the camera, deadpan expression, whole body in frame from head to boots. Photoreal, no text, no logos.
